decision: Keep verified V6; no tested candidate passes validation.

evidence_settings.positive: Exact stereochemical canonical SMILES; assay description contains normalized cell name; IC50/EC50/MIC/MIC50 with relation =, positive finite reported value and no validity flag; no explicit Not active in that cell. In-fold cell mapping requires >=3 positive-evidence training rows, all non-sentinel. Replace with active-only ExtraTrees prediction.
evidence_settings.numeric: Exact stereochemical canonical SMILES plus normalized cell; usable_for_training rows only; require max SI <= 1.2 * min SI, use median; no train/test competition concentration columns.
evidence_settings.soft: Equal average of correction and baseline prediction.
evidence_settings.selection_warning: Published external labels can disagree with competition annotations; one training sentinel has exact external SI=11 in the same cell. Do not overwrite it automatically.

kernel_ablation.settings: Tanimoto kernels: Morgan radius 2 and 3, 2048 bits with chirality; RDKit 2048-bit path fingerprint; equal average of those three. Optional 50% cosine TF-IDF char kernel (2,6), vocabulary fitted inside fold. Ridge alpha .01/.1/1. Targets and predictions capped 10000. Existing inactivity correction. Blend weights .25/.5/1 with V6. GroupKFold seeds 42/2026/117.

limitations: Leaderboard values do not reveal competing methods or establish a rules violation.
These are repeated exploratory CV comparisons, not an independent holdout.
No new candidate was submitted to Kaggle.
